turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
Open mind. You haven't answered me, Hale: who decided, and was Owen heard before it went in?
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
It says I'm giving you twenty minutes before I do. Was Owen heard, yes or no?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
No. You put a zero in the gradebook without a phone call, so show me what you have.
